sentences.en: During that winter, writing occupied most of my free time.
sentences.zh: 那个冬天，写作占据了我大部分空闲时间。

sentences.en: I think I will occupy myself in my father's business.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我会在我的父亲的生意上忙活。

sentences.en: Occupying powers never consider an insurgency's cause to be valid.
sentences.zh: 占领政权从不认为叛乱的原因是正当的。

senses.zh: 占据，占用；占领，占据（地方）；使忙碌，占用（时间）；担任，从事（职业）
